title: Architecture
content:
next adds a real automatic semantic builder while preserving the v0.1 authority boundary:

public-document allow-list
  → evidence extraction
  → Agent semantic proposal
  → deterministic validation
  → KnowledgeRevision
  ├→ human-review graph
  └→ CognitivePackageDraft → A3S Use generation

Domain model {#domain-model}

Workspace, KnowledgeScope, Evidence, SemanticProposal, KnowledgeRevision, and CognitivePackageDraft keep their existing responsibilities. A3S Use continues to own package installation, locking, and publication state.

Quality {#quality}

The real builder adds deterministic artifact digests, incremental-change receipts, citation-coverage evaluation, and disclosure regression tests.

title: Agentic Ontology next documentation
content:
next records unreleased evolution. It is not evidence that a capability has shipped, production scale has been validated, or the real semantic builder is live.

Planned evolution

Replace Playground mock data with automatically built semantic artifacts.

Keep the public contract for learning events, graph nodes, relationships, and cognitive-package previews stable.

Add real citation coverage, package-generation diffs, and usage feedback to continual evaluation.

Keep source code and internal implementation out of public build artifacts.

Use the version selector to return to v0.1 for the current demo contract.

title: Playground
content:
The next release will replace build-time mock data with automatically built semantics while preserving the three linked regions: Agent learning events, a human-review 3D ontology, and an A3S Use cognitive-package preview. The six-stage build run in the center must also consume real receipts rather than infer lifecycle outcomes from frontend state.

Compatibility requirements

Events continue to include time, public document, understood knowledge, created semantics, and target Revision.

Events continue to highlight graph nodes and relationships.

The package preview continues to show package schema, surfaces, revision, and publication state.

The keyboard semantic list continues to share filters, citations, and relationship data with the 3D graph; non-WebGL environments enter that list automatically.

The build run continues to show the objects, authorities, gates, and receipts for Scope, Evidence, Review, Revision, Package, and Evaluation.

When A3S Use or A3S Code has not issued a receipt, later stages remain waiting or blocked and never synthesize success.

Package contract {#package-contract}

The real builder must not add source-location fields, emit an Agent graph-query payload, or promote unverified Agent output directly into canonical knowledge.

title: Quick start
content:
next keeps Node.js 22, npm 11, and the same static build entry point:

npm install
npm run build

Use npm run dev for the product site, npm run dev:playground for the 3D Playground, and npm run dev:docs for versioned docs.

A new semantic builder must emit the current public contract and pass npm run check:public before its output can be assembled into GitHub Pages.

title: Versioning
content:
next uses /agentic-ontology/docs/next/; English uses /agentic-ontology/docs/next/en/. It always keeps a version prefix and never replaces the default v0.1 route.

Promoting a new default version requires Chinese/English page parity, public-graph contract compatibility, a passing privacy gate, Playground interaction regression coverage, and GitHub Pages route checks.
